title: The Seeker
description:
The Seeker is a classic retro RPG featuring a party of characters following an exciting quest.STORY:
Join four orphans as fate calls upon them for a role greater than they could have ever imagined!
Prove yourself worthy of becoming a Seeker and defeat the Unholy Beast hellbent on ruling over those you care for!FEATURES:
• Classic Storyline

• Dynamic Party System

• Fun & Witty Dialogues

• Secret Rooms to discover
